snippet.title: RavenQuest: Munk Madness | Official Expansion Trailer
snippet.description:
The Munk Carnival is here, along with major improvements, balance patches, and massive new systems! 

What's Included:

► The Munk Carnival: Try your luck at Moa Racing, the Fortune Wheel, and Lucky Raffles.

► New Pet System: Adorable companions to join you on your Adventures.

► Massive PvP Updates: Experience all-new GvG updates and conquer territory with the new Open World PvP Monolith.

► New High-Stakes System: More danger, more challenges, and more rewards in Expeditions & Aether Echoes.

► Plus: New themed mounts, a major balance patch, and tons of new content to explore.

Follow us as we prepare to experience the Madness!
